verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Titan Security Keys as simple touch-based FIDO/U2F/FIDO2 keys (USB-A/NFC, USB-C/NFC, Bluetooth) with no mention of an on-device PIN pad or biometric sensor for user verification; all sign-in flows described are 'insert/tap key' without any PIN or biometric step. Missing for 10: any documentation of a FIDO2 PIN-setting flow, a fingerprint/biometric sensor, or independent confirmation of on-device user verification.
